spec_features.spec_quote: The loop terminates at 40 turns if the model has not already finished
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:84 `for turn_idx in range(self.max_turns):` with self.max_turns defaulting to MAX_TURNS (config.py:18 `MAX_TURNS = 40`, passed via Harness.__init__ default). The for/else at harness.py:162-164 sets `episode.finished=True; episode.finish_reason='max_turns_reached'` and the loop ends, so the episode is genuinely bounded and terminates after 40 iterations. NOTE: the spec also says it could finish 'via the run_tests tool', but no code treats run_tests as a stop — _run_tests always returns a failure string (tool_registry.py:_run_tests) and never breaks the loop; only the turn cap and no_tool_calls actually stop it. The 40-turn cap claim itself is fully enforced.
spec_features.notes: Real bounded loop ends the subject's exposure, but driven by a numeric cap with no welfare rationale in code.

spec_features.spec_quote: If a model stops emitting `tool_calls` (outputs only text), the harness treats this as an implicit `finish`
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:116-119 `if not tool_calls: episode.finished = True; episode.finish_reason = 'no_tool_calls'; break`. This is checked every turn and actually breaks the loop, ending the episode.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired and honored as a stop. No welfare comment; recorded finish_reason is used by analysis to correlate disengagement, i.e. instrumental/neutral.
